components.title: An agent is a loop with an exit.
components.insight: Plan, act, observe, repeat. The exit condition is the part that makes it safe.

source.label: Conceptual agent loop
source.reference: Teaching diagram, not a trace of a real agent run

components.title: Retrieval ranks. It does not verify.
components.insight: Top-ranked chunks are candidates. The answer still has to cite what it used.

source.label: Synthetic similarity scores
source.reference: Scores are invented for teaching, not measured retrieval quality

components.title: A check has two outcomes.
components.insight: Name what happens on failure before you ship the happy path.

source.label: Conceptual validation gate
source.reference: No real request or policy was evaluated

components.title: Retries need a ceiling.
components.insight: Back off between attempts, cap the count, and park what still fails.

source.label: Conceptual retry policy
source.reference: Wait values are examples, not measured backoff

components.title: Answer from the cheapest tier that knows.
components.insight: A cache hit skips the model. A miss falls through. Both are decisions.

source.label: Conceptual memory tiers
source.reference: No hit rates or latencies are measured here

components.title: Route by the job, not by habit.
components.insight: A classifier picks the smallest model that can do the task. Escalate on doubt.

source.label: Conceptual model routing
source.reference: Model names are placeholders, not provider recommendations

data.rule: Short input, low risk: small model

components.title: Type the boundary.
components.insight: A tool schema is a contract. Required fields and types are checked before the call.

source.label: Example tool schema
source.reference: Field names are illustrative, not a real API

components.title: Every stage has a gate.
components.insight: Promotion is a decision with evidence, not a timer.

source.label: Conceptual deployment stages
source.reference: Gate names are examples, not a release policy

components.title: Know which layer you are changing.
components.insight: Prompt edits and schema edits live in different layers with different blast radius.

components.title: Read the guard, not just the call.
components.insight: Three lines decide whether the tool runs. Annotate those, not the boilerplate.

source.label: Illustrative Python snippet
source.reference: Not executed; API names are invented

components.title: Context is a budget.
components.insight: System prompt, retrieved text and the answer share one window. Reserve headroom.

source.label: Illustrative token split
source.reference: Numbers are round examples, not a measured request

components.title: A request has states, not vibes.
components.insight: Every transition is named. Nothing goes from received to executed without review.

source.label: Conceptual state machine
source.reference: Illustrative transitions, not a production workflow engine

components.title: Show the change, not the adjective.
components.insight: Before and after, side by side, with the direction marked. Numbers stay as given.

source.label: Illustrative refactor summary
source.reference: Values are examples, not measured benchmarks

components.title: Where did the request spend its time?
components.insight: Nested spans show what ran inside what. The model call is one span among several.

source.label: Synthetic request trace
source.reference: Durations are examples, not a production trace
